text: Status: all seven TAs have replied and the department sent the official week. No full hour is free for everyone next week; I've picked the slot that costs nobody a change and I'm writing it into the calendar now — details in a moment.

**CSE455 staff meeting — booked.**

Tuesday 24 November, 15:00–15:30, in my calendar.

Why that slot: I asked all seven TAs (Sarah, John, Priya, Diego, Hana, Omar, Maya) for their week and got the department's official schedule for Mon 23 – Fri 27. The honest result: nobody has a full free hour, and there is **no hour next week that works for all of us**.

- Tue 11:00–12:00 is the only hour the department has completely clear — but John and Hana are busy 11:00–11:30 and every TA is busy 11:30–12:00.
- Tue 15:00–16:00 and Wed 10:00–11:00 would need *every* TA plus me to move something.
- Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30 is the one half-hour where all seven TAs and I are free, and the department schedule has nothing running.

So I've made it a 30-minute meeting and nobody has to change a thing. If you'd rather have the full hour, say which day matters most and I'll ask the TAs to shift — several have offered.
